install_output_empty: Nogat autput yet. Ol 'terminal line' bilong 'install tool' bai kamap hia.
linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome: Setim SP Flash Tul bilong Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Daunlodim na stretim 'high-speed flashing engine' bai yu ken stretim na apdetim pilaia bilong yu isi tru.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek 'native flashing tool' wantaim 'universal library compatibility' i stap.
linux_card_usb_desc: Givim tok orait long desktop long toktok wantaim pilaia long Bootloader mode.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Gutpela verifikasen bilong ol draiva, kernel modul, ol tok orait, na ol 'runtime' laibreri long mekim gutpela 'flashing'.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Redim kompyuta bilong yu long konektim long pilaia bilong yu long kisim ol 'software' apdet.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Sekim 'advanced Linux setup' bilong SP Flash Tool, USB akses, 'serial permissions', na ol sistem komponen.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Redim kompyuta bilong yu long konektim long pilaia bilong yu na putim ol sofwet apdet gut.
settings_checker_desc: Redim kompyuta bilong yu long konektim long pilaia bilong yu na putim ol sofwet apdet gut.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompiuta bilong yu i redi long konektim long pilaia bilong yu.
linux_prep_ready: Redi, SP Flash Tool i redi.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Pilaia i painim, nupela koneksen akses...
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Yu ken konektim pilaia bilong yu taim ol i askim yu.
linux_prep_blocked: Dispela kompyuta i no inap ranim SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Yu mas yusim paswod bilong yu wanpela taim long setim dispela kompyuta long 'flash': ol rul bilong USB bilong ol MediaTek divais na 'serial port access'.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Long setim dispela kompyuta long SP Flash Tool, yu mas yusim paswod bilong yu long neks step long stretim ol USB rul na putim akaun bilong yu long ol serial yusa grup yu nidim. Sapos yu no laik, aplikesen bai pas.
linux_prep_needs_access: Ol i no bin givim tok orait long go insait, flashing i nidim.
linux_prep_fixed: Yu ken go insait, SP Flash Tool i redi.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Setup i pinis na akaun bilong yu i go insait long ol yusa grup we yu nidim long SP Flash Tool. Plis kirapim gen kompyuta bilong yu bai ol nupela tok orait i ken wok, na bihain opim ap gen. Klikim mak bilong pasim ap nau.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Pinis, pasim Ap long kirapim gen kompyuta
settings_driver_desc: Pastaim long yusim dispela ap long namba wan taim, yu mas putim MediaTek USB draiva, na bihain kirapim gen kompyuta bilong yu.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Oto-Fiks Ol Rait na Setim Sistem
home_desc: Painim 'firmware' long intanet o makim wanpela 'local package', na bihain 'flash' long divais bilong yu.
home_step_1: Yu mas makim model bilong divais bilong yu
home_step_2: Yu mas makim sofwet na daunlodim
sel_source_desc: Daunlodim 'firmware' long intanet, o kisim wanpela 'local package'.
settings_advanced_desc: Soim rot bilong putim, rot bilong putim na ol filta bilong rilisim.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Givim mi long rot bilong putim insait long ap
settings_guided_install_desc: Dispela ap i stap wantaim yu taim yu pasim pawa, konektim, na putim.
settings_sp_gui_install: Putim insait long SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Pasim Updater na opim SP Flash Tool GUI wantaim 'firmware scatter' fail na ol piksa bilong 'patition' we yu makim pinis.
settings_terminal_desc: Ranim sofwet instolesen bilong yu long Terminal bai yu ken lukim ol teknikel infomesen long wok i wok long kamap.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Ranim sofwet instolesen bilong yu long Command Prompt bai yu ken lukim ol teknikel infomesen long wok i wok long kamap.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Opsenel. Sampela MediaTek taget i no laik 'flash' inap SP Flash Tool i kisim wanpela 'authentication' (.auth) fail; putim bilong yu long hia sapos divais i nidim wanpela.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Nogat wanpela 'scatter file' i stap insait long dispela paket, olsem na ol i no inap wokim wanpela 'console command'.
terminal_install_no_tool: Nogat SP Flash Tool bild o MTKClient entry point i stap bilong dispela rot.
terminal_install_failed: No inap opim wanpela terminal windo. Ol i raitim 'install command' i go long {path}.
status_terminal_install: Instalim komand i op long terminal windo bilong yu ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} bai op nau na ran {method}.

• Sapos em i no pas yet, pasim pawa bilong {device} bilong yu.
• Sapos em i konektim long USB, rausim pastaim.
{hint}
• Konektim divais bilong yu long kompyuta bilong yu taim {terminal_name} windo i op.

Klikim OK long kirapim na lusim Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tip: Sapos divais i no konek otomatik, isi isi presim reset baten insait long pinhol wantaim wanpela pepa klip taim yu konektim USB kebol.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tip: Putim divais bilong yu long 'firmware download mode' (i save senis long wanwan model: e.g. rausim bateri na putim ausait wantaim USB kebol i konektim, o pasim pawa wantaim bateri i stap insait, o holim Volium Daun/Ap taim yu konektim USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Putim long SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI bai op nau wantaim 'firmware' bilong yu i stap pinis.

• Insait long SP Flash Tool, makim "Daunlodim" long dropdaun bokis.
• Klikim "Daunlodim" baten.
• Mekim gut olsem {device} bilong yu i no gat pawa na i no konek.
{hint}
• Konektim USB kebol long kompyuta bilong yu bihain long yu klikim Daunlodim.

Klikim OK long opim SP Flash Tool na lusim Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Taim yu opim, ol Rockbox tim i save go long Y1 na Y2 bihain long yu putim Rockbox gut.
themes_placement_failed_note: Mipela i no inap long putim ol 'themes pack' long pilaia bilong yu. Yu ken traim gen long Seting.
settings_rockbox_desc: Yu yusim taim yu lukluk long ol 'software releases'.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Soim ol 'Original Software' rilis we i winim 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ol orijinel Software rilis we i olpela moa long 3.0.7 i no inap long wok wantaim ol Y1 yunit we ol i salim wantaim Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Sapos yu flasim wanpela olpela 'build' long ol dispela yunit, dispela bai pasim ol long 'boot' inap long taim ol i putim nupela 'version' gen.

Yu save tru olsem yu laik soim ol 'Original Software' rilis we i olpela moa long 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Soim ol 'build' we ROM zip bilong en i 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p bild i no inap long wok wantaim Y1 yunit long Innioasis OS aninit long 3.0.7, olsem na soim olpela Rockbox bild i op wantaim em.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ol rilis bilong Rockbox-Y1 pastaim long 0.5 i no inap long wok wantaim ol Y1 yunit we ol i salim bihain long Mas 2026 wantaim Innioasis OS 3.0.7 i stap pinis.

Sapos yu 'flash' wanpela olpela 'build' long ol dispela masin, dispela bai pasim wok bilong kirapim.

Yu laik soim olpela Rockbox bild?
sel_back_to_online: ← Go bek long Onlain Sistem Software
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Plis makim wanpela .zip, .rar arkiv, o wanpela 'scatter file' (*scatter*.txt) insait long wanpela 'firmware' folda long putim 'firmware' yu makim long {target} bilong yu.
sel_offline: Ol lista long intanet i no stap nau. Yusim wanpela lokol fail, o sekim koneksen bilong yu.
sel_no_release: Nogat rilis i stap bilong dispela sofwet
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Planti 'firmware' paket o 'scatter' fail i bin stap insait long dispela folda/arkiv. Plis makim wanpela folda o 'archive' we i gat wanpela 'firmware package' tasol long wanpela taim.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Dispela rilis i gat moa long wanpela 'scatter' fail, olsem na 'Updater' i no inap long tokim wanem 'layout' pilaia bilong yu i nidim. Divelopa bilong {software} bai nidim long apdetim ol 'firmware' rilis bilong ol long putim wanpela 'scatter' fail tasol.
sp_search_restart: Nogat divais yet, wok long painim gen (traim {count}). Larim pilaia i no gat pawa na konektim taim ol i askim yu.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fail bilong tok orait i no stap ({path}); i lait na i no gat dispela.
sp_config_missing_platform: Dispela 'scatter' fail i no tokaut long 'platform' bilong en, olsem na ol i no inap long wokim 'console configuration' bilong 'authentication file'; i lait na i no gat dispela.
sp_config_missing_storage: Dispela 'scatter file' i no tokaut long wanpela kain 'storage type' (EMMC/NAND/UFS), olsem na ol i no inap long wokim 'console configuration' bilong 'authentication file'; i lait na i no gat dispela.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Nogat wanpela 'authentication' fail i bin kamap; i lait na i no gat wanpela.
sp_config_write_failed: Mi no inap raitim 'console configuration file'; i lait na i no gat fail bilong 'authentication'.
settings_notifications_desc: Soim ol toksave bilong sistem bilong ol kain toksave na apdet aninit. Off i save holim olgeta samting insait long ap.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Larim ol toksave taim ap i pas
settings_add_device_type_hint: Taip em i 'hardware' bilong pilaia. Ol pilaia bilong wankain model i ken kamap long moa long wanpela rivisen — eksampel Taip A na Taip B — na ol i wokim sofwet bilong wanpela bilong ol. Sekim stika long baksait bilong pilaia; sapos em i no kolim nem bilong wanpela kain, lusim namba wan mak.
settings_add_device_no_versions: I no gat ol vesen bilong dispela sofwet i stap nau.
settings_add_device_pick_version: Yu mas makim wanpela vesen bilong sevim.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Ol toksave bilong sistem i no stap long dispela kompyuta.
settings_run_in_background_group: Ranim long bekgraun bilong kisim ol toksave
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Putim ap long menu bar bihain long windo i pas, bai yu kisim yet ol toksave bilong ap na pleia femwea. Off: pasim windo bai lusim ap.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Putim ap insait long sistem trei bihain long windo i pas, bai yu kisim yet ol toksave bilong apdeit bilong ap na pilaia femwea. Off: pasim windo bai lusim ap.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Haitim 'online community catalog' na putim sofwet long ol lokol fail tasol.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Yu bin flasim wanpela 360p Rockbox bild. Yu laik putim 360p Theme Pack long dispela divais nau?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Konektim Pleia long USB Storage Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Plis rausim USB, opim pawa na kirapim Rockbox wanpela taim (olsem na em i kirapim intanel .rockbox sistem folda bilong en), bihain konektim gen USB na makim 'USB Storage Mode'.

Taim yu konektim, klikim Go het long makim wanpela folda long pilaia bilong yu.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Makim wanpela folda long stoa bilong pilaia bilong yu
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack i bin stap gut long divais bilong yu!
sel_themepack_failed: Instolesen bilong Theme Pack i no kamap gut: {err}
sel_only_local: Kisim wanpela .zip o .rar 'firmware package', o wanpela 'folda / scatter .txt' fail, bilong putim long oflain, yu no nidim intanet. Em i wok wantaim olgeta Innioasis na Timmkoo odio pilaia.
sel_only_local_generic: Kisim wanpela lokol 'firmware package' (.zip, .rar) o wanpela folda we i gat wanpela 'scatter file' bilong putim long oflain, i wok wantaim ol jenerik MediaTek divais.
sel_offline_install: Putim 'firmware' long wanpela .zip o .rar fail long wanpela Innioasis o Timmkoo odio pilaia.
sel_offline_install_generic: Putim 'firmware' long wanpela .zip/.rar arkiv o 'firmware' folda long ol jenerik MediaTek divais.
sel_update_available: I gat wanpela apdet i go long {software} i stap bilong {model} bilong yu.
notices_dialog_empty: I no gat ol toksave nau.
conn_offline: Yu no stap long intanet. Ol install long Community Firmware Archive i no stap.
conn_archive_unavailable: Ol i no inap long kisim 'firmware catalog' inap sotpela taim. Yu ken instalim yet long 'archive' o long ol lokal fail.
single_instance_body: Narapela kopi i op, o i wok yet long bekgraun. Tupela kopi bai resis long kisim USB koneksen bilong pilaia, olsem na dispela wanpela bai no inap stat.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi we i wok long ron i no bekim askim long soim windo bilong en. Ating em i bisi o i hangamap. Sapos yu fosim em long lusim, dispela bai pasim olgeta samting em i wok long putim.
single_instance_force_failed: Ol i no inap pinisim kopi we i ran. Yu yet i mas lusim, na bihain kirapim gen 'updater'.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi we i ran i wok long instalim sofwet o toktok wantaim pilaia, olsem na sapos yu pinisim nau dispela bai pasim dispela. Dispela lonsing bai pas; yusim windo we i stap pinis o menu bar aikon bilong en taim install i pinis.
notices_how_community: Ol toksave bilong komyuniti i wok olsem wanem
notices_summary_body: Opim ol toksave insait long ap long ritim ol.
toast_battery_charged: Pastaim long yusim dispela long pilaia bilong yu, sasim bateri inap long wanpela aua
toast_battery_charged_device: Pastaim long yusim dispela long divais bilong yu, sasim bateri inap long wanpela aua
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Larim ol 'background notifications' i ken kisim ol 'update' na 'issue alert' maski 'Updater' i pas long 'menu bar'.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Larim ol bekgraun notifikesen i ken kisim ol apdet na ol toksave bilong hevi maski Updater i pas long sistem trei.
toast_release_notes_unavailable: Ol toksave bilong rilis i no stap nau.
translate_unavailable_notice_title: Ol toksave bilong rilis trenslesen i no stap
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Ol sevis bilong tanim tok long intanet i no inap long kisim o i stap long 'cooldown'. Ol bai soim ol 'original notes' bilong rilis.
translate_unavailable_hint: Translesen i no inap long sotpela taim. Sekim intanet koneksen bilong yu o traim gen bihain.
update_store_available_fmt: {new} i stap long Microsoft Store (yu gat {current}).
sel_prepare_done: Paket i redi, stat long putim
sel_notes_hint: Makim wanpela rilis long lukim senis log bilong en
flash_wait_desc: Pawaim masin pastaim. Sapos em i konek tasol yu no luksave long en, traim narapela USB kebol o pot.
dialog_pre_install_header: Plis meksua olsem {model} bilong yu i no gat pawa na i no konektim long USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Ofaim olgeta pawa bilong divais bilong yu pastaim long yu statim.
• Sapos divais i ais o i no wok, yusim wanpela pin o pepa klip insait long hul bilong 'reset' long fosim pawa i go long daunlodim mod.
• Noken konektim USB kebol nau.
• Klikim Go het, na konektim divais bilong yu long USB taim ol i askim yu.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Ofaim olgeta pawa bilong MediaTek divais bilong yu.
• Noken konektim USB kebol nau.
• I dipen long model, traim long konektim wantaim o nogat bateri (o holim volium daun / antap taim yu konektim).
• Klikim 'Continue', na bihain konektim USB kebol taim ol i askim yu.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Mipela i no inap holim data bilong yu long dispela install bikos 'firmware' bilong yu nau i no inap long wok wantaim Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Katim USB kebol na yusim wanpela 'peperclip' o 'pin' long presim 'reset' baten, na bihain traim long konektim gen.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Em i gutpela long konektim pilaia long wanpela 'wall charger' inap 30 minit i go inap wanpela aua pastaim long yu traim long konektim.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Sapos yu yusim Windows, yu mas putim ol draiva.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Ol Windows PC i mas stat gen bihain long yu putim draiva pastaim long yu yusim namba wan taim.
flash_keep_settings_option: Holim ol seting na midia bilong mi
keep_data_running_fmt: {software} i stap pinis long {model} bilong yu?
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Dispela sofwet i stap pinis long {model} bilong yu?
install_first_which_firmware: Wanem sofwet i wok long {model} bilong yu nau?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Sapos yu no klia, makim 'Narapela' o sofwet yu ting i stap pinis.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Long go het wantaim dispela install, plis konfemim sapos {model} bilong yu i ranim pinis ol 'base software' ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Mipela i ken holim ol seting na midia bilong yu tasol taim pilaia i ranim pinis dispela sofwet o wanpela kompatibel vesen.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Mipela i ken holim ol seting bilong yu tasol taim pilaia i ranim pinis dispela sofwet o wanpela kompatibel vesen.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Mipela i ken holim ol seting na midia bilong yu tasol taim pilaia i ranim pinis dispela sofwet o wanpela kompatibel vesen.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Larim ol i holim ol seting na midia long olgeta 'firmware' install
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: I lusim askim bilong 'compatibility'. Yusim dispela tasol taim yu save olsem pilaia bai wok yet wantaim ol seting na midia bilong en.
err_keep_data_failed: No inap long holim ol seting na midia bilong yu: folda bilong 'firmware' i no inap long raitim. Nogat wanpela samting i bin stap.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Kipim ol seting na midia bilong yu long pilaia. Ol narapela sofwet i stap olsem oltaim.
flash_keep_data_warning: Sapos yu no mekim dispela, ol seting na midia bilong yu bai stap gen long intanel stoa bilong pilaia.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Sapos yu no mekim dispela, ol bai rausim ol 'theme', 'font' na 'setting' bilong Rockbox bilong yu. Musik na ol narapela midia bilong yu bai stap long pilaia.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Sapos yu no mekim dispela, ol bai rausim ol 'Rockbox' tim, ol 'font' na ol 'setting' bilong yu, na 'internal storage' bilong pilaia bai kamap gen.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Sapos yu wok yet na yu no mekim dispela, ol seting bilong yu bai kamap gen. Musik na ol narapela midia bilong yu bai stap long pilaia.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Dispela 'firmware' i mas senisim 'internal storage' bilong pilaia. Ol seting yu bin sevim bai ol i rausim; musik na ol narapela midia bilong yu bai stap yet.
format_all_data_warning_other: Dispela 'firmware' i mas senisim 'internal storage' bilong pilaia. Ol seting na midia we yu bin sevim na yu bin putim long 'built-in storage' bai ol i rausim. Ol midia long microSD bilong yu i stap yet.
format_all_confirm_question: Fomatim gen intanel storage long {model} bilong yu?
format_all_confirm_body:
Long {software} mipela i mas senisim 'internal storage' bilong {model} bilong yu pastaim long mipela i ken go het. Orait bai ol i traim narapela SP Flash Tool, tasol long Fomat Olgeta + Daunlodim mod long rot bilong XML konsol-mod ran.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Katim USB, na putim wanpela 'peperclip' o 'pin' insait long 'reset pinhole' long {model} bilong yu. Klik Neks long traim gen long Fomat Olgeta + Daunlodim mod.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool i ripotim olsem 'partition table' bilong pilaia i senis (8502). Dispela 'firmware' i mas stap long 'Format All + Download mode', we i save 'format' gen long 'internal storage'.
install_first_hint: Pastaim long yu setim {target} long namba wan taim, {model} bilong yu i mas ranim {software} — o {target} yet, sapos em i stap pinis na i wok.
install_first_version_fmt: {model} bilong yu i inapim pinis mak bilong {software} ({version})?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Plis rausim USB, opim {model} bilong yu na klikim Neks.
install_first_power_on_hint: Larim pilaia i stat wanpela taim long 'base firmware', na bihain pasim pawa bilong en long neks install.
install_first_need_body: {target} i wok gut taim yu stat wantaim {software} long {model} bilong yu. Mipela bai putim {software} pastaim, na bihain mipela bai go het long {target} otomatik.
install_first_when_body: {target} i no ken stap stret antap long {running}. Long {model} bilong yu, pilaia bai no inap stat gut bihain. Sapos yu putim {software} pastaim em i gutpela rot, na {target} bai bihainim em yet.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} i no ken stap stret antap long sofwet we i stap pinis long {model} bilong yu: pilaia bai no inap stat gut bihain. Sapos yu putim {software} pastaim em i gutpela rot, na {target} bai bihainim em yet.
install_first_recommend_body: {model} bilong yu i wok long ran {running}. Sapos yu putim {target} antap long en, dispela inap long holim {running}'s statap logo na ol kastom divais logo. Sapos yu putim {software} pastaim em i gutpela rot: {target} bihain em i bihainim em yet. Yes i putim {software} pastaim; Noken putim {target} nau wantaim ol nupela seting na midia.
install_first_base_done: {software} i stap pinis. Go het wantaim {target}.
install_first_missing: Dispela 'firmware' i nidim {software} pastaim, tasol katalog i no gat 'installable' rilis bilong {software}.
install_first_version_unavailable: Dispela 'firmware' i nidim {software} {version}, tasol nogat wanpela rilis insait long katalog i wankain olsem dispela samting.
install_first_needs_answer: Dispela 'firmware' i nidim wanpela 'base firmware' sekim, we i nidim wanpela 'interactive terminal'.
keep_data_microsd_reassurance: Midia bilong yu long microSD bilong yu i save stap long ples bilong en oltaim
keep_data_erase_prompt_y1: Putim na rausim ol seting long {model} bilong yu?
keep_data_erase_prompt_other: Putim na rausim ol seting na midia long intanel stoa long {model} bilong yu?
keep_data_erase_explainer_y1: Ol seting bai kamap gen, tasol musik na ol fail long microSD kad bilong yu bai stap yet. Try anyway
keep_data_erase_explainer_other: Ol seting na intanel stoa midia bai stap gen, tasol ol midia long microSD kad bilong yu bai stap yet. Try anyway

support_page_cycle_story: Bilong wanem mipela i mekim dispela ↻
support_story_1_headline: Taim ol kampani i wokim ol samting i go het, ol manmeri i save kirap.
support_story_1_lead: Lukautim divais bilong yu long ol 'silent hardware trap' na ol 'broken revision'.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis i save kamapim ol nupela 'firmware' bilong ol pilaia olsem Y1 (ol i save makim ol 'hidden board' olsem 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) we i save brukim olpela divais. Samting nogut moa, websait bilong ol i no givim wanpela tok lukaut na i no gat rot long kisim ol 'firmware' we i bin wok long bipo long kisim bek long wanpela 'bricked state'. Updater na Community Firmware projek i kisim ol samting: mipela i save putim olgeta 'legacy stock ROM', na sekim otomatik 'hardware revision' bilong yu, na mekim pilaia bilong yu i wok gut.
support_story_1_item_1: Kisim bek ol pilaia we i bruk: Ol sefti sekim i mekim na ol nupela apdet i no inap bagarapim olpela 'hardware'.
support_story_1_item_2: Ol Stok ROM we ol i bin putim long arkiv: Olgeta koleksen bilong ol 'factory firmware' we Innioasis i bin rausim.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Ol ful flashing tul bilong macOS, Linux, na Windows wankain.
support_story_1_item_4: Hatwea Intelejens: Otometik bod diteksen bai yu kisim stretpela paket oltaim.
support_story_2_headline: Nogat ol Google Draiv i bruk. Nogat wok bilong tingim. Fimwea i wok tasol.
support_story_2_lead: Ol infrastraksa bilong komyuniti we i gat bikpela spit na ol i bin sekim na yu ken dipen long en.
support_story_2_body: Long painim ofisel Innioasis sofwet i min olsem yu mas painim ol Google Drive link we i pinis, ol Baidu klaut sea we i dai pinis, na ol 'mystery zip' fail we i no gat ol 'flashing tools'. Mipela i wokim wanpela gutpela, indipenden daunlod netwok wantaim SHA-256 integriti, ol apdet notifikesen, na ol step-bai-step gaided install. Ol donesen bilong yu i save holim ol daunlod na hosting we i mekim dispela i kamap 24 aua long wanpela de, 365 de long wanpela yia.
support_story_2_item_1: Dairekt Hai-Spid CDN: Ol daunlod i go hariap na i no gat mak bilong daunlodim o ol link i dai pinis.
support_story_2_item_2: Ol toksave bilong apdetim: Kisim toksave long taim ol nupela komyuniti rilis o stretim i kamap.
support_story_2_item_3: Gaid Step-bai-Step Instol: Ol klia piksa i soim yu long olgeta taim yu presim ol baten.
support_story_2_item_4: Multilingwal Komyuniti: Ol i save yusim long tok Inglis, Saina, Jeman, Spen, Frans na Japan.
support_story_3_headline: Opim ful pawa bilong Innioasis pilaia bilong yu.
support_story_3_lead: Bringim Rockbox, ol kastom laitweit opereting sistem, na fridom bilong ol manmeri i save harim musik.
support_story_3_body: Ol 'stock factory' sofwet i save skrapim tasol ol samting we Y1 o Y2 'hardware' bilong yu inap long mekim. Komyuniti bilong mipela i bringim Rockbox, ol laitpela kastom opereting sistem, ol 'audiophile codec playback', na ol kastom tim i kam long laip. Mipela i save baim ol kain kain 'physical hardware' bilong testim, 'reverse engineer', na sekim olgeta taim mipela i putim. Sapotim Updater i save givim mani stret long ol dispela tes yunit na i save hariapim wok bilong kamapim ol 'custom firmware'.
support_story_3_item_1: Wanpela-Klik Rockbox: Audiophile pleibek na ol kastom tim i stap insait long sampela seken tasol.
support_story_3_item_2: Komyuniti Femwea: Ol samting bilong bateri i kamap gutpela moa, UI i klin moa, na ol moden odio kodek sapot.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Mipela i save testim ol 'real physical devices' pastaim long mipela i rilisim wanpela 'build'.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% fri, praivesi-pastaim sofwet we i no gat ol edvetaismen o bihainim.
support_story_4_headline: Helpim mipela long mekim ol samting we Innioasis i no save mekim.
support_story_4_lead: Komyuniti-pawa femwea presevesen i mekim ol divais bilong yu i stap longwe long ol ples pipia.
support_story_4_body: Taim wanpela kampani bilong 'hardware' i go long narapela 'gadget' bilong ol, ol i save lusim olpela 'gadget'. Innioasis i no givim Linux sapot, i no gat ol 'transparent changelogs', na i no gat isi rot long kisim bek taim wanpela install i feil. Updater i stap bikos ol manmeri i gat bikpela laik long yusim musik i no ken tromoi wanpela gutpela musik pleia. 100% bilong ol kontribusen bilong komyuniti i go stret long opim dispela tul long olgeta manmeri.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows maski ol divais i no laik kirap.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Fes-Klas Sapot: MediaTek i gat ful sapot long ol Linux distro.
support_story_4_item_3: Ol 'Transparent Changelogs': Ol toksave bilong rilis we i klia tru bai yu save gut long wanem ol senis i kamap.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Komyuniti i givim mani: Olgeta kopi i save opim 'archive' na fri long olgeta manmeri.

dl_resuming_fmt: Stat gen long daunlodim long {mb} MB...
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool i stap wantaim libpng12 kompatibiliti.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Klikim Re-check o kirapim gen setup long daunlodim paket.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Ol rul bilong MediaTek i wok (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Desktop akses i op.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Givim tok orait wanpela taim bai ap i ken toktok wantaim divais bilong yu.
linux_perms_ok_title: Ol tok orait i kamap pinis
linux_perms_ok_msg: Ol tok orait bilong USB na ol rul bilong udev i stap gut. Ol sevis i stap pinis.
donate_rely_on_you: Helpim mipela long ol 'running costs' bilong mipela, givim tude.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Opim MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: Ap i go bek long ol 'default' bilong en, daunlodim 'cache' i pinis, na 'battery reminder' i kamap gut gen.
log_app_reset_defaults: Konfiguresen bilong ap i go bek long ol 'default', 'download cache' i pinis, na 'battery reminder' i kamap gen (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Wetim pilaia bilong yu long stat gen...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Putim em i stap insait long plag, Rockbox i wok long stat na ol 'themes' bilong en bai kamap otomatik.
flash_watch_found: Pilaia i painimaut, putim ol 'Rockbox' tim...
flash_watch_timeout: Pilaia bilong yu i no kam bek yet.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Sekim olsem em i pas long pawa na i on. Sapos em i tudak yet, presim wanpela pin i go insait long hul bilong 'reset' na holim senta baten (Y1) o pawa baten (ol narapela pilaia) long kirapim gen. Sapos em i no stat yet, 'firmware' i no kisim, putim narapela.
action_brom_detected: Divais i stap long BROM mode...
action_downloading_da: Daunlodim DA i go long divais...
action_format_succeeded: Flash fomat i bin kamap gut...
action_flash_complete: Flash i pinis! Katim USB na kirapim gen.
action_recover_powercycle: Pawa-saiklon long pilaia (holim pawa ~10s), na konektim gen - traim gen...
action_wait_mtk: Wetim MTK divais... Pawaim divais na konektim USB.
action_da_stall: Divais i stop long bekim taim yu wok long konfigurim daunlod ejen. Pawaim olgeta, konektim gen, na traim gen.
action_detected_brom: Device detected (BROM mode) - konfiguring download agent...
action_detected_preloader: Device detected (preloader mode) - konfiguring download agent...
action_da_wait_back: Pilaia i stop long bekim taim em i kirapim 'download agent'. Wetim em i kam bek...
action_device_connected: Divais i konektim - redim ol rait komand...
action_restart_brom: Statim gen pilaia long BROM mode...
log_install_writing: Yu wok long putim - raitim ol piksa bilong 'firmware'...
log_sparse_fmt: Piksa bilong Android i no gat planti mani long {part}, na i wok long senisim taim em i wok long kamap...
err_code_connection_failed: No inap long konektim long divais
err_code_mtk_import_failed: MTKClient i no inap long kisim
err_code_sp_not_found: SP Flash Tool i no stap
err_code_missing_images: Ol piksa bilong 'firmware' i no stap insait long paket
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Verifikasen bilong patisen tebol i no bin kamap bihain long raitim
err_sp_wrong_model: Yu bin konektim rong model bilong pilaia. Klikim × baten long rausim dispela install, na bihain makim sofwet bilong pilaia yu konektim.
err_sp_timeout: Dispela tul i no bin lukim pilaia. Yu mas pasim pawa na rausim plag, na bihain konektim USB kebol taim ol i askim yu.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Pilaia i kirap hariap tumas. Pawaim olgeta, na konektim gen.
err_sp_download_fail: Rait i bin stop. Sekim USB kebol na pot na bateri sas, na traim gen.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Ejen bilong daunlodim i no inap long stat. Traim narapela rot bilong 'flash'.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Ol i no inap salim daunlod ejen i go long pilaia. Ofaim pawa na konektim gen.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Pilaia i sakim daunlod ejen (rong 6104). Yusim Download Agent we i stap wantaim SP Flash Tool, na sekim sapos 'firmware' i wankain olsem dispela pilaia.
err_sp_com_port: Dispela tul i no inap long opim 'serial port' bilong en. Pasim ol narapela tul we i save lait na konektim gen.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: USB COM pot i no inap long op (rong 1013). Sapos yu kirapim gen kompyuta bilong yu, dispela bai lusim 'port' we i pas. Plis kirapim gen kompyuta bilong yu na traim gen.
err_sp_enable_dram: Dispela tul i no inap long kirapim memori bilong pilaia. Yusim paket we ol i wokim bilong dispela model stret.
err_sp_storage_read: Dispela tul i no inap long ritim stoa bilong pilaia. Sekim koneksen; ating dispela masin i gat hevi long 'hardware' bilong en.
err_attempt_timeout: Dispela tul i lait i no soim wanpela samting i kamap insait long {seconds} seken, olsem na ol i stopim dispela traim.
err_connection_failed_desc: I no inap long kamapim gutpela koneksen wantaim pilaia. Mekim gut olsem divais i no gat pawa (yusim wanpela pin long presim 'reset' baten sapos yu nidim), rausim USB, na konektim gen taim ol i askim yu.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Flashing i bin stop o rait operesen i no bin wok. Sekim olsem USB kebol i pas gut na bateri i gat inap sas, na traim gen.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Flas i luk olsem i pas
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Dispela 'flashing tool' i soim wankain lain long las {seconds} seken na i no luk olsem em i wok long raitim 'firmware'. Ating 'flash' i no wok gut. Sapos dispela em i laspela bilong tupela traim wantaim wanwan rot long wanpela sistem we inap pundaun namel long tupela, o sapos MTKClient tasol i stap long dispela masin, kirapim gen kompyuta na traim gen.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient tasol i stap bilong dispela install. Ating 'flash' i no wok gut. Plis kirapim gen kompyuta na traim gen.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Dispela kompyuta tu i ken yusim SP Flash Tool. Sapos yu inap, senisim i go long SP Flash Tool na traim gen.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Ating 'flash' i no wok gut. Plis ritim dispela toksave antap na kirapim gen kompyuta pastaim long yu traim gen. Sapos yu klikim OK, ap bai pinis na yu ken kirapim gen.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Dispela 'firmware' paket i no gat 'scatter file' o ol 'image file' we yu nidim. Plis daunlodim gen dispela paket o makim wanpela ful 'firmware' fail.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Fail bilong Autentikesen i no inap long yusim
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fail bilong 'authentication' yu makim i no stap, em i stap nating o yu no inap long raitim. Yu mas makim wanpela fail we i stret, o kliarim long Seting, na bihain flasim gen.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Tul bilong lait i no stap
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ol i no inap long kirapim 'flashing tool' o ol 'system driver' we ol i nidim. Plis sekim ol tok orait bilong sistem, setup bilong draiva, o instalim gen aplikesen.
err_driver_missing_desc: Dispela asua inap kamap taim MediaTek USB draiva i no stap. Klikim Download Drivers long putim MediaTek USB draiva, kirapim gen kompyuta bilong yu, na traim gen.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Wanpela 'cached firmware' fail i no stap. Yu mas makim 'Select Software' long wokim gen ol fail yu bin rausim o daunlodim gen 'firmware archive'. Dispela em i wanpela hevi bilong lokol fail, i no hevi bilong USB koneksen.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Go bek long Selektim Software long wokim gen o daunlodim 'firmware' paket.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Yu mas makim wanpela 'firmware' rilis long daunlodim gen.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Wanpela asua i kamap taim yu putim ({detail}). Ofaim pawa bilong pilaia olgeta, konektim gen taim ol i askim, na traim gen.
flash_method_confirm: Rot bilong putim i senis i go long {method}. Yu mas sekim olsem pilaia i no stap long plag na i no gat pawa, na bihain klikim Neks.
flash_failover_note: {method} i no bin kirapim wok bilong putim. Bihain long ol i pasim na rausim pawa bilong pilaia, bai ol i yusim {other}.
themepack_card_desc: I gat ol naispela komyuniti tim, ol hai-resolusen bekdrop, na ol font we ol i wokim stret long 360p displei.
themepack_step1_title: Step 1: Konektim long USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Holim pawa baten, opim pilaia bilong yu.
2. Taim Rockbox i kirap, putim USB kebol i go insait long kompyuta bilong yu.
3. Sapos yu kisim askim long skrin bilong pilaia, konfemim USB Storage mode bai divais i kamap olsem wanpela draiv.
themepack_step2_title: Step 2: Makim wanpela folda long pilaia
themepack_step2_desc: Bikos ol opereting sistem (olsem macOS) i save haitim ol dotfail (olsem .rockbox) long 'default', yu ken makim WANPELA folda o 'drive root' long pilaia bilong yu. Mipela bai painim o wokim .rockbox dairektori bilong yu.
themepack_btn_select_folder: Yu mas makim folda long pilaia...
themepack_complete: Theme pack i bin kamap gut! Nau yu ken rausim 'player' bilong yu na makim wanpela 'theme' insait long Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: No inap painim o kirapim wanpela .rockbox dairektori long draiv yu makim. Plis meksua olsem yu makim wanpela folda long pilaia bilong yu.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Step 1: Kirapim gen pilaia na konektim gen
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Katim USB kebol.
2. Larim pilaia i go bek na larim em i go insait long Rockbox.
3. Taim Rockbox i wok pinis, konektim gen USB kebol, na bihain presim Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Step 2: Painim pilaia antap long ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ap i wok long lukluk long wanpela ADB koneksen (inap long 30 seken). Sapos ol i painim wanpela divais, ol i save senisim ol 'theme' na pilaia i save kirap gen. Sapos nogat, go het long USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Wetim wanpela ADB divais... (inap long 30 seken)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Ol i painim divais ({serial}); transferim ol tim...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Nogat ADB divais i kamap insait long 30 seken; go het wantaim USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Nogat ADB binary i stap long ap; go het wantaim USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Pusim ol tim na ol font antap long ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB trensfe i no kamap gut; pundaun i go bek long USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Larim USB Storage Mode long pilaia bai em i kamap olsem wanpela draiv.
2. Pikim WANPELA folda long pilaia aninit (.rockbox, Music, Themes, o draiv rut, wanpela .rockbox folda i stap hait i stap otomatik).
3. Dispela ap i bungim ol 360p tim na ol font, na raitim antap long ol fail we i gat wankain nem.
rockbox_wizard_done_title: 360p ol tim na ol font i stap pinis!
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Nau yu ken rausim 'player' na makim wanpela 'theme' insait long Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
rockbox_stage_installing: Putim ol Rockbox Themes na Fonts...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Nupela sofwet bilong yu i bin stap, tasol olpela .rockbox folda i no inap long rausim. Rausim .rockbox folda long pilaia long han sapos yu laik stat gut.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Moa long wanpela pilaia i konektim. Katim koneksen bilong ol narapela na lusim wanpela tasol we ol i putim.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Pilaia i painimaut. Putim ol komyuniti tim na font...
rockbox_stage_pushing_files_fmt: Putim ol fail bilong het tok ({curr} bilong {total})...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Holim senta baten long kirapim Y1 bilong yu, konektim gen USB, na makim USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Holim pawa baten long kirapim pilaia bilong yu, konektim gen USB, na makim USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Divais i no stat? Kisim bek namba wan sofwet
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Plis rausim na opim {model} bilong yu, na bihain presim Neks
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Katim USB, holim {button} long kirapim {model} bilong yu, na bihain presim Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Konektim {model} bilong yu long USB, givim pawa long en, na bihain presim Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Plis makim pilaia yet o .rockbox folda
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Yu wok long putim ol Rockbox tim bilong wanem pilaia?
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Plis konektim {model} bilong yu long USB
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Plis opim USB storage mode long divais bilong yu na klikim Neks
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Plis opim USB storage mode long {model} bilong yu, na bihain makim draiv we i kamap
